author: Inside Edition
description: There was panic at a preschool as a 2-year-old boy choked on candy. The toddler’s frantic father patted his back, but it wasn’t helping. That’s when Yolanda Willis, who runs the Head Start program in Burke County, Georgia, jumped in. Grabbing the boy around his stomach, Willis performed the Heimlich maneuver and cleared his airway. She and the boy’s mother, Felicia Freeman, spoke with Inside Edition.
title: Georgia Head Start Director Saves Choking 2-Year-Old Boy

author: Inside Edition
description: Fans of Hayden Panettiere were shocked earlier this year by the actress' sudden death. The 36-year-old "Nashville" star died of an accidental drug overdose. In a sign of just how troubled Hayden's family life was, her own mother didn't attend her funeral. Now, in an exclusive interview, Hayden's mom, Lesley Vogel, tells Inside Edition's Eva Pilgrim why she became distant from her daughter in recent years.
title: EXCLUSIVE: Hayden Panettiere's Mother, Lesley Vogel, Speaks Out To Eva Pilgrim

author: Inside Edition
description: After a seven-year search, it has been announced that Robert Pattinson will star in the iconic “James Bond” franchise last played by Daniel Craig. The search for the perfect James Bond kept the world guessing. There were rumors Idris Elba, Tom Hardy, Aaron Taylor-Johnson and Henry Cavill were under consideration. Pattinson is best known for blockbusters “Twilight” and “The Odyssey.” So far there have been 25 “James Bond” movies and the franchise has won six Academy Awards.
title: Robert Pattinson’s ‘James Bond’ Role Comes After 7-Year Search

author: Inside Edition
description: There were more cancellations and delays Monday as repercussions continued from Friday's nationwide grounding of all planes. But one group of stranded strangers came up with a solution. The five passengers drove from Chicago’s O’Hare airport to Nashville, an eight-hour trip.  They documented their adventure on social media. Now they are being compared to TV’s iconic “Golden Girls.” They spoke with Inside Edition's Steven Fabian.
title: 5 Strangers Drive To Nashville Together After Nationwide Flight Grounding

author: Inside Edition
description: After two days of silence, President Donald Trump blamed the nationwide ground stop former President Joe Biden’s Administration and pushed for an overhaul of aging infrastructure. Trump also responded to reports that he has been lying low because of threats on his life from Iran. Trump holed up in the White House over the weekend, breaking cover just once for a round of golf. He brushed off the threats on Monday.
title: President Trump Blames Biden Administration For Ground Stop

author: Inside Edition
description: A reality television star was reportedly arrested in Turkey after allegedly being involved in a fight that left a 17-year-old dead. Reports say it happened in the coastal resort town of Bodrum. João Franco, a yacht captain who had been part of the Bravo series, “Below Deck,” was arrested with his brother in connection with the brawl, according to reports. The brothers allegedly got into a verbal altercation at a clothing store that turned physical. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Former ‘Below Deck’ Star João Franco Arrested After Teen Dies During Fight

author: Inside Edition
description: A cat was found alive days after an apartment building collapsed in Brooklyn, leaving at least eight people dead and many more injured. The mayor’s office posted this video of the cat being carried out by rescuers.His name is Isaac and he belongs to a 13-year-old girl named Zariah. They were reunited at the veterinarian’s office that is caring for Isaac. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Cat Found Alive Days After Building Collapse In Brooklyn Reunited With Owner

author: Inside Edition
description: Staff at Save the Chimps got creative to feed a stranded and hungry chimp. Historic flooding in Florida last week brought nearly two feet of rain, prompting a state of emergency and the evacuation of almost 200 people. At the St. Lucie County animal sanctuary, over 200 chimpanzees were safely brought inside, except Kaleb, who was stranded on the island cut off by floodwaters. So staff used modern technology to deliver food to him. Inside Edition Digital has more.
title: Animal Sanctuary Uses Drone To Feed Stranded Chimpanzee

author: Inside Edition
description: Producers announced Monday that Robert Pattinson will be the seventh iteration of 007. “James Bond is one of the most legendary characters in cinema, and to be entrusted with 007 is the honor of a lifetime,” the actor said. His competition was said to include Josh O’Conner, Callum Turner and Jack Lowden. Filming for the 26th James Bond film is slated to begin in 2027.
title: Robert Pattinson Is The New James Bond

author: Inside Edition
description: A rambunctious 7-year-old cat in Amsterdam named Nimis has become an accidental social media star. His owner, Lydia Faber, says she first dressed the feline in a yellow life jacket to make sure he didn't drown in the canal. Then she added a "police" patch for fun. Then Lydia started posting videos of Nimis and his baby brother Boef on social media so relatives far away could see them. She had no idea her account was public until one video went viral. Inside Edition Digital has more.
title: Life Jacket-Wearing ‘Police Cat’ Steals The Spotlight
